notes.title: New Story/Mode
notes.content: Hi! This time I added a new mode called "Lost Tapes". It's a linear horror-oriented story where you can get a better look at the "monsters" lurking under the bed. WARNING! The new mode contains quite drastic and disturbing scenes which are quite different from those in "First Mission" or "Rescue Mission".

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
I deleted some "missing data" screens that were unnecessarily wasting the player's time and swapped them with "Dark Hole" views.

"Use: Rope" bug fixed.

(I made this fix some time ago and I don't really remember what else I changed) :P

notes.title: New Mode
notes.content:
The game has been expanded with a new "Rescue Mission" mode which makes it easier to regain memories. This is a linear mode recommended for people who can't find all the locations containing memories.

Each mode is described with a short description.

I also fixed a few bugs, but don't worry about that :P
